newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Former Sri Lankan prime minister dead.
newsitem.headline: Former Sri Lankan prime minister dead.

text.p: A former Sri Lankan prime minister, Wijayananda Dahanayake, died on Sunday at a private hospital at his home town in the southern Galle district.
He was 95 and had been ailing for some time.
Dahanaike served as premier for six months after the assassination of prime minister Solomon Dias Bandaranaike of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party (SLFP) government in September 1959.
His brief tenure ended when the next general election, in March 1960, was won by the United National Party.
Dahanayake was a member of the leftwing Lanka Sama Samaja Party before joining the SLFP administration. He also served as minister of education, home affairs and agriculture.
